## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Linked task or issue

- Task: T-XXX
- Fixes #<issue-number>
- Closes #<issue-number>

## Milestone

- M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 / M5

## Reviewer comment

Add a short review comment explaining the objective, key risks, and validation.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests run
- [ ] Linting or static checks run if applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is up to date with target branch

- [ ] Task linkage is included in the PR body
- [ ] Changelog or docs are updated if necessary
